title: NEFT explained - support procedure
content: For a synthetic NEFT enquiry, prepare a fictional beneficiary and explain the requested transfer without executing it. Check the reference and transaction status in the trusted banking channel if a previous transfer is delayed; do not assume a guaranteed credit time.
